newsitem.title: USA: Cabot extends Beaurline natgas field.
newsitem.headline: Cabot extends Beaurline natgas field.

text.p: Cabot Oil & Gas Corp said on Thursday that it had extended its Beaurline natural gas field in Texas with the completion of its Beaurline 12 well, which tested at nine million cubic of natural gas and 28 barrels of condensate per day.
The well was completed at depths of 11,800 feet to 12,560 feet with over 200 feet of net pay in the Vicksburg Sand on the North McAllen Ranch structure.
Two more wells are planned for the area along with a 3-D seismic survey on acreage adjacent to the existing field.
Cabot's 1997 Gulf Coast exploration program also includes a 10 well program to be drilled in the Hostetter area of McMullen County. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
